cues.zh: 英语里有太多难懂的词了，但我觉得在美国最难的词，就是“Shit”。
cues.en: There are so many difficult words, and I think the hardest word, in America, has been the word, "Shit."

cues.zh: 我本以为这很简单……以为自己知道“shit”是什么意思，结果证明，我特么根本一无所知！
cues.en: I thought it's easy... that I know what "shit" means, but it turns out, I didn't know shit!

cues.zh: 我觉得这是最复杂的词了。怎么会这样呢，如果某样东西很烂，它是“shit”；
cues.en: I think it's the most complicated word. Like, how could it be, if something is bad, it's shit?

cues.zh: 但如果特别棒，它又是“THE shit”了。
cues.en: If something is really good, it's THE shit.

cues.zh: 我打破脑袋也猜不到啊！
cues.en: I would have never guessed that!

cues.zh: 我——我不得不专门去研究这玩意儿。
cues.en: I-- I had to study that shit.

cues.zh: 冠词太重要了。比如——比如要是我——要是“I give shit”，
cues.en: So important, the article. Like-- like if-- if I-- if I give shit,

cues.zh: 如果“I give shit to you”，意思是，呃，我在训斥你；但如果“I give A shit”，
cues.en: If I give shit, to you, that means that ,uh, that I'm telling you off, but if I give A shit

cues.zh: 哎，那意思是我在乎！
cues.en: Well, then I care!

cues.zh: 要是“I take shit”——如果“I take shit”，意思是我任由你欺负我；
cues.en: And if I take shit-- if I take shit, then I accept that you are bullying me,

cues.zh: 但要是“I take A shit”……
cues.en: but if I take A shit...

cues.zh: 我——我去拉了个屎。
cues.en: I-- I take a shit.

cues.zh: 我还发现，我的 shit 永远是好的、正面的，但你的 shit、他的 shit、她的 shit——全都很烂。
cues.en: And I learned that my shit is always good and positive, but you're shit, his shit, her shit - always bad.

cues.zh: 比如，“我受不了她的破事；我得忍他的破事；把你的破事收拾干净；
cues.en: Like, "I can't deal with her shit; I have to put up with his shit; Clean up your shit;

cues.zh: 但别碰我的破事！”
cues.en: But don't touch my shit!"

cues.zh: 然后——然后我了解到，呃，如果有人说“我有破事要干”，
cues.en: And-- and then I learned that, uh, that if somebody says I have shit to do,

cues.zh: 它可以指任何活动，
cues.en: it can refer to any activity,

cues.zh: 不管是什么。
cues.en: whatsoever.

cues.zh: 任何！只有一个例外……
cues.en: Any! Except one...

cues.zh: 那就是真的拉屎。
cues.en: Actually shitting.

cues.zh: 没人去洗手间的时候会这么说。
cues.en: Nobody says that, when they're going to the bathroom.

cues.zh: 没人，除了我。
cues.en: Nobody, except me.

cues.zh: 我就爱这么干。我——我——我就爱这么干。
cues.en: I love to do that. I-- I-- I love doing it.

cues.zh: “呃，我得走了。我有破事要干。”
cues.en: "Uh, I have to go. I have shit to do."

cues.zh: “呃，你要去干什么？”
cues.en: "Uh, what are you going to do?"

cues.zh: “我已经告诉你了。”
cues.en: "I have already told you."

cues.zh: 然后我了解到，“还有破事”这个说法，
cues.en: Then I learned that the phrase, "AND shit,"

cues.zh: 没有任何意义。
cues.en: doesn't mean anything.

cues.zh: 如果有人说“还有破事”，那——
cues.en: If somebody says, "and shit," it'--

cues.zh: 那什么都不是。
cues.en: it's nothing.

cues.zh: 只是你随口加的，让列举听起来更长。
cues.en: It's just something that you say, to make your list sound longer.

cues.zh: 比如有人说，“哦，我喜欢旅行，还有破事，”
cues.en: Like if somebody says, "Oh, I like to travel, and shit,"

cues.zh: 你得知道他们只喜欢旅行。
cues.en: you have to know that they ONLY like to travel.

cues.zh: 更复杂的是，shit 还能再分成 a piece of shit。
cues.en: And to make it even more complicated, shit can be divided into a piece of shit.

cues.zh: 而那意思完全不一样。
cues.en: And that has a completely different meaning.

cues.zh: a piece of shit 是烂片、破车，或者一个自私的人。
cues.en: A piece of shit is a bad movie, a lousy car, or a person who is being selfish.

cues.zh: 而 piece of shit 可以越来越大，
cues.en: And the piece of shit can get bigger and bigger,

cues.zh: 但它永远不可能是 WHOLE shit。
cues.en: but it can never be the WHOLE shit.

cues.zh: 比如——比如，如果我是 a piece of shit，那我是在自私，
cues.en: Like-- like, if I'm a piece of shit, I'm being selfish,

cues.zh: 如果我是 GIANT piece of shit，那我就更自私！
cues.en: and if I'm a GIANT piece of shit, I'm even more selfish!

cues.zh: 但如果我是 THE shit，那我棒极了！
cues.en: But if I'm THE shit, I'm great!

cues.zh: 非常感谢！谢谢，我是 ISMO！
cues.en: Thanks a lot! Thanks, I've been ISMO!

cues.zh: 感谢观看！想看更多，还有更多！
cues.en: Thank you for watching! If you wanna see more, there is more!

cues.zh: 所以，请多看一些，点击 SUBSCRIBE，也请分享，谢谢，下次见！拜！
cues.en: So, please watch some more, and click SUBSCRIBE, and please share, and thank you, and see you again! Bye!
